name: JODI-Oil primary database: crude oil production, total crude exports and refinery intake, monthly, four reporting countries
source: JODI-Oil (Joint Organisations Data Initiative), primary annual CSV downloads
license: JODI-Oil public data: free public access, attribution to JODI/UNSD required; no re-sale
license_note: No dedicated JODI terms-of-use page was found on 2026-11-26; robots.txt allows the download paths used, the data-downloads page is public and the footer states 'Copyright JODI 2026'. The licence line is the project's public-data attribution reading, not a quoted formal licence.
coverage: SA, US, CA, NO; 2024-09 .. 2026-09 (25 months); series: crude oil production (INDPROD), total crude exports (TOTEXPSB), refinery intake (REFINOBS); 300 rows, all values present in KBD; the suggested RU/IQ/AE were checked first but the JODI primary CSV reports no KBD values for them (empty/missing), so they were replaced by CA and NO, which report all three series
notes: Compact aggregate slice only: one product (CRUDEOIL), three flows, four countries, 25 months. Raw JODI annual CSV files (8-12 MB each) were streamed and not stored or committed; only this small table is pinned. KBD unit selected; KBBL monthly totals, other units/products and secondary estimates are not included. No vintages/PIT: JODI publishes revisions and country submissions with lags; these are the latest published values at the retrieval date. Not for resale; attribution to JODI/UNSD.
